docs(biz42): the home page product describes the new story and its pages

## Intent

The home page now tells its story solution first and moves the details to Features, Mitmachen and Über uns. Chapter 10 still described the old page (problem, four portraits, principles, why free, sceptics), so people and AI assistants reading the docs got a wrong picture.

## Key changes

- The home page product says: the home page promises learning apps with no strings attached, shows apps from the catalogue, says what teachers and parents get, and then speaks to makers. Features, Mitmachen and Über uns hold the details.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Describes the home page of lernapps.github.io from ec471f2 on.
